Top Fully Funded Scholarships for Bangladeshi Students in Europe

Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters

Erasmus Mundus is often the strongest fully funded master’s route for a Bangladeshi graduate. Students apply to the consortium running their chosen joint programme, not through one central scholarship form.

A precise motivation letter matters. An environmental-science graduate, for example, could connect a European climate programme to flood-adaptation work in coastal Bangladesh. Generic praise for “quality education in Europe” says very little.

Stipendium Hungaricum

Stipendium Hungaricum is the clearest undergraduate scholarship for Bangladeshi students in this list. The programme’s Bangladesh partner information confirms access to full bachelor’s, master’s, one-tier master’s and doctoral study through the Secondary and Higher Education Division.

Current support includes tuition-free education, HUF 43,700 per month at bachelor’s and master’s level, a dormitory place or HUF 40,000 monthly towards accommodation, and medical insurance. The programme warns that this may not cover every living cost, particularly private rent in Budapest.

Applicants must follow both the Hungarian portal and Bangladesh’s sending-partner instructions when the 2027-28 call appears.

DAAD EPOS Scholarships

DAAD EPOS funds selected development-related postgraduate courses in Germany. It does not fund every German degree.

Applicants normally need a relevant bachelor’s degree and at least two years of professional experience. Current support provides €992 per month for graduates or €1,400 for doctoral candidates, with insurance and possible travel, rent or family support. The official DAAD EPOS listing already contains the 2027-28 courses and their individual deadlines.

Here’s the thing: course fit matters more than a famous university name. A civil engineer working on flood-resistant infrastructure can make a stronger case for water management than for an unrelated business course.

Before choosing a programme, check how German public universities handle tuition and other charges.

Swedish Institute Scholarship

The SI Scholarship for Global Professionals supports eligible master’s applicants with work and leadership experience. Bangladesh appeared in the latest published eligible-country list.

The latest terms covered full tuition, SEK 12,000 per month and a one-off SEK 15,000 travel grant. Applicants should check the official SI Scholarship page when the 2027-28 call appears, as country rules and required experience can change between cycles.

This route does not suit an HSC graduate. It rewards a record of professional contribution and a credible plan for using the degree afterwards.

Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships

Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships for 2027-28 mainly target early-career researchers who have completed a master’s degree. Research and PhD applicants need a detailed proposal and written support from a Swiss academic supervisor.

Applications open on 20 August 2026 for study starting on 1 September 2027. The award provides CHF 2,450 per month. Postdoctoral scholarships will not be offered from the 2027-28 academic year. Applicants should use the official Swiss 2027-28 scholarship page.

A mildly surprising point: finding the right supervisor often takes longer than completing the application. Five carefully targeted messages usually work better than one generic email sent to fifty academics.

France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship

France Excellence Eiffel supports selected master’s and doctoral applicants. Students cannot apply directly. A French higher-education institution must nominate them.

The current allowance is €1,200 per month at master’s level and €2,100 per month at doctoral level, with selected travel, insurance and accommodation-related services. Eiffel does not automatically cover every programme cost, so confirm the fee position with the institution. The application route appears on the official Campus France Eiffel page.

The 2027 campaign is pending. Contact the intended university early because its internal nomination date may come first.

The latest published terms for these awards come from their respective government or programme websites. New calls may change the amounts, country lists or dates.

These are useful secondary options, but they should not displace a stronger profile match. A €5,000 Dutch award can still leave a substantial tuition bill.

Students considering destinations beyond Europe can compare other major fully funded opportunities.

Scholarship for Bangladeshi Students After HSC

Stipendium Hungaricum is the clearest government-funded route after HSC. University tuition waivers in Hungary, Finland, Italy and the Netherlands may also reduce costs, although many are partial.

Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters, DAAD EPOS, SI and Swiss research scholarships do not suit students applying directly after HSC. Start with the correct study level, then compare lower-cost European destinations before assuming a partial award makes an expensive course affordable.

Can Bangladeshi Students Get Scholarships in Europe Without IELTS?

Sometimes. There is no universal scholarship for Bangladeshi students without IELTS.

A university may accept TOEFL, PTE Academic, Cambridge English, a Medium of Instruction certificate, previous English-medium education or its own assessment. Erasmus consortia set their own requirements, while DAAD applicants follow the selected course.

Eligibility and Documents

General Eligibility

There is no single European CGPA requirement. Strong results help, but relevant experience and a specific motivation letter can carry real weight.

Documents Required

Prepare a passport, academic certificates and transcripts, CV, motivation letter, recommendation letters and accepted language evidence. Depending on the award, you may also need employment records, a research proposal, portfolio or university offer.

How to Apply for a Scholarship in Europe from Bangladesh

  1. Match the award to your study level. HSC graduates should not spend weeks preparing for master’s-only scholarships.
  2. Verify Bangladesh eligibility and the official route. Some programmes use a consortium, some require university nomination, and Hungary also uses a sending partner.
  3. Tailor the application. Use evidence, not adjectives, and follow a structured scholarship application process rather than sending the same statement everywhere.

2027-28 Application Timeline

  • August to October 2026: Prepare Swiss and DAAD applications, request transcripts and contact referees.
  • October 2026 to January 2027: Monitor Erasmus Mundus programmes and the new Stipendium Hungaricum call.
  • January to March 2027: Check Swedish, French, Irish, Italian and university-based calls.

Students who are still organising admission, documents and destination choices can build a wider study-abroad plan from Bangladesh.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is There a Full Free Scholarship for Bangladeshi Students in Europe?

Which Scholarship Is Best for Bangladeshi Students in Europe?

Erasmus Mundus often fits a recent graduate seeking a funded master’s. Stipendium Hungaricum covers more levels, DAAD EPOS and SI suit experienced applicants, and Switzerland focuses on research.

Can I Apply for a European Scholarship After HSC?

Yes. Stipendium Hungaricum is the clearest option here. Some universities also offer partial undergraduate tuition awards.

Can I Apply Without IELTS?

What CGPA Is Required?

There is no Europe-wide minimum. Providers consider grades alongside course fit, experience, references, leadership and the motivation letter.

When Should I Apply for the 2027 Intake?

Preparation should begin by August 2026. Major applications may run from late 2026 to early 2027, but every programme sets its own deadline.

Final Thoughts

Finding the right scholarship for Bangladeshi students in Europe starts with matching the award to your study level, experience and financial position. Erasmus Mundus may suit a recent graduate, Stipendium Hungaricum offers one of the clearest routes after HSC, while DAAD, SI and Swiss scholarships generally favour experienced professionals or researchers.
